findings.finding: Onboarding relied solely on withAuthority holding authority; no explicit post-await current/entry-expiry checks. Ready could accept missing/nonfinite credential facts from an injected store.
findings.repair: Required literal-true isCurrent(recipe, operation), pre/post I/O checks, entry lifetime checks, copied entry request/handle, finite positive credential/grant revisions and deadlines, token/grant references and explicit unrevoked state. Local cancel/revoke remain possible after access expiry.
findings.proof: Authority loss across load/approval/entryRequest/issue/handoff, stale ready projection, malformed credential facts and expiry during issue regressions.

findings.finding: OAuth callback reused mutable session/entry objects and lacked current-session/expiry checks after capture and delivery.
findings.repair: Snapshot query/session/entry facts; required literal-true session guard before capture and after capture/delivery; use original handles and compare original request.
findings.proof: Session/handle/query mutation, revocation/expiry during capture/delivery; real PostgreSQL duplicate encrypted capture and original answer reuse.

findings.finding: Private reconciliation checked only request equality and abort, allowing a late verified/not_applied result without current factual-read authority.
findings.repair: Required isCurrent(binding, phase) before and after reconciliation; dispatch phase retains current worker lease/grant/cancel checks. Reconcile phase permits authorized factual accounting after Stop/expiry without replay/readiness.
findings.proof: Authority loss before/after reconciliation and authorized post-Stop factual read with denied dispatch.

findings.finding: Mutable private input/exchange result could be substituted across awaits; refresh-token registrations and extra recipe fields were not excluded.
findings.repair: Snapshot token and exchange primitives; reject non-API tokens and unexpected recipe fields. Preserve malformed expiry values for rejection rather than JSON-normalizing NaN/Infinity to null.
findings.proof: Private token substitution, malformed exchange deadlines, refresh token/extra payload, failed/ambiguous claim and concurrent synthetic claim regressions.

findings.proof: Reproduced 46 pass/1 fail; corrected 53 pass/0 fail, including historical replacement, missing review, all four source drifts and unavailable-source regressions.

boundaryAudit.approval: Only server host approvePersistentAccess literal true permits requestAccess issuance; caller setup/grant are hints, not authority. Host must persist human approval of full recipe; requestAccess belongs only on authenticated human routes. The example agent tool can only use an existing native grant.
boundaryAudit.identity: Recipe/request/destination/original effect snapshots are immutable across adapter work. Current host checks must bind tenant/user/project/account/environment/purpose, original task/job/native/route/instruction revisions, Meta app/user/account and grant/lease. New-job alias prevention is native authority, not a claim derived from request shape.
boundaryAudit.secrecy: Only enums, fixed blocked reasons and opaque nonbearer host handoff routes leave the adapter; callback codes and tokens stay in entry/client/custody ports. Thrown private errors are suppressed. No reference-only imports occur in the distributed optional adapter/example.
boundaryAudit.durableClaims: Claim CAS, private retain/invalidate and exact-effect reconcile remain required injected native services. Narrow synthetic fixtures prove boundary behavior, not independent persistence of the host claim across rollback/crash.
boundaryAudit.unknownEffects: Recorded unknown connection effects stay unknown across reconnect/local revoke. Current native connection contract has no domain-owned unknown-to-ready resolution. No repair to that generic contract, replacement job, new grant or retry bypass was introduced.
boundaryAudit.transport: No fetch/client implementation or live registration added. Generic vault-request is unchanged and still rejects query strings and unsafe destinations. A future Meta transport needs explicit policy resolution for private exchange/query requirements versus token-URL prohibition; suppressing logs is not a waiver.
boundaryAudit.trustLimit: SDK cannot authenticate a lying host boolean or enforce a client falsely labelled synthetic. Installed host evidence is mandatory; runtime flags are not a network sandbox.
